test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Ramesh is fond __at__ playing guitar in his free time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**of**" is the correct choice because it is used to indicate a liking or fondness for something.
 
• The sentence suggests that Ramesh enjoys playing the guitar during his free time. The proper grammatical structure is "fond of" and not "fond at" or any other prepositions.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context, as they do not pair correctly with the word "fond."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Ramesh is fond **of**__ playing guitar in his free time."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "for"** is incorrect because "fond for" is not a valid phrase in English.
 
• **Option 2: "on"** is incorrect because "fond on" is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 4: "in"** is incorrect because it is not the correct preposition to use with the word "fond."
